mapper.select: SELECT book_index_id, book_id, custom_price, unlock_at, free_from, free_until, version, create_time, update_time FROM chapter_commercial_policy WHERE book_index_id = #{bookIndexId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chapter_commercial_policy (book_index_id, book_id, custom_price, unlock_at, free_from, free_until, version) VALUES (#{bookIndexId}, #{bookId}, #{customPrice}, #{unlockAt}, #{freeFrom}, #{freeUntil}, 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE book_id = VALUES(book_id), custom_price = VALUES(custom_price), unlock_at = VALUES(unlock_at), free_from = VALUES(free_from), free_until = VALUES(free_until), version = version + 1
